sg_factory_guide.text: This was the oil factory. Whales came up the slipway on the plan, were flensed, chopped and boiled in the digesters. The oil went to lamps, soap and margarine. Nothing went to waste, except the whales.

It closed in 1965 and the station sat for decades, shedding bits. The island's cleaned it up now, asbestos and all, and it's a museum with its own opinions. Mind the plates, they're sharp. That's the sort of thing the whalers said about the weather.
You'll like the oil tanks outside, by the way. Don't go in them. Nobody goes in them. People have written to me.
